extractor: read directly from the official IND page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
structure_note: ELIGIBILITY HERE IS A SET OF ALTERNATIVES, NOT A CHECKLIST. IND writes 'one of these situations applies to you' and then lists four routes. The four route_* requirements are therefore officially_required = false individually, with one_qualifying_situation carrying the actual obligation. Marking each route as required would tell an applicant they need a Dutch degree AND an Erasmus Mundus master's AND scientific research AND a top-200 foreign degree.
not_extracted: The general requirements that apply to everyone. Linked, not stated.
The specific ranking tables themselves. IND names the three publishers; the rankings are live external documents and change annually.
The Code of Conduct for international students, the Civic Integration Act 2021 and the Civic Integration Decree provisions IND cites — all separate legal instruments, two of them Dutch-only.
Different requirements that may apply to Turkish citizens and their family members, which IND flags but handles elsewhere.
Fee exceptions. Only the headline EUR 254,00 is recorded.
The start-up entrepreneur permit IND names as an alternative for graduates who want to found a company.

requirements.label: Meet the general requirements that apply to everyone
requirements.description: IND links a separate general-requirements page, not a registered source.
requirements.source_excerpt: you meet the general requirements that apply to everyone .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You meet the general requirements that apply to everyone.

requirements.label: ONE of the qualifying situations must apply — they are alternatives, not a checklist
requirements.description: The structural point of this permit. IND lists four alternative routes (Dutch degree, Erasmus Mundus master's, scientific research in the Netherlands, or a foreign degree from a top-ranked institution). An applicant needs ONE, not all. Recording them as parallel conditions would imply otherwise.
requirements.source_excerpt: one of these situations applies to you:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: One of these situations applies to you:

requirements.label: Route: scientific research in the Netherlands in the 3 years before applying
requirements.description: One of the alternative routes. Not officially required in itself — see one_qualifying_situation. IND adds that the contract job code from the university job classification system (UFO) must start with 01 to count as scientific research.
requirements.source_excerpt: you have conducted scientific research in the netherlands in the 3 years before the date of application.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You have conducted scientific research in the Netherlands in the 3 years before the date of application.

requirements.label: Route: a master's degree from an Erasmus Mundus joint programme in the last 3 years
requirements.source_excerpt: you obtained a master’s degree in the 3 years before the date of application in the context of an erasmus mundus joint master programme.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You obtained a master’s degree in the 3 years before the date of application in the context of an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme.

requirements.label: Route: an accredited Dutch bachelor's or master's, or a post-master's of at least 10 months
requirements.source_excerpt: an accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree programme at a dutch higher education institution. a post-master’s study programme in the netherlands for at least one academic year (at least 10 months).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: An accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree programme at a Dutch higher education institution. A post-master’s study programme in the Netherlands for at least one academic year (at least 10 months).

requirements.label: Route: a foreign degree from an institution in the top 200 of at least 2 of 3 named rankings
requirements.description: The three publishers are Times Higher Education, Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) and ShanghaiRanking Consultancy. A live external test, assessed as at the graduation date — not a static list.
requirements.source_excerpt: your educational institution is in the top 200 of the general rankings or the rankings by subject of at least 2 of the 3 publishers. your educational institution is in the top 200 of these rankings on the date of your graduation or promotion.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your educational institution is in the top 200 of the general rankings or the rankings by subject of at least 2 of the 3 publishers. Your educational institution is in the top 200 of these rankings on the date of your graduation or promotion.

requirements.label: A subject ranking must be for your own study or research subject
requirements.description: IND also allows combining a general ranking with a subject ranking, provided they are from different publishers.
requirements.source_excerpt: is your educational institution in a ranking by subject? in that case that ranking must be about your study or research subject.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Is your educational institution in a ranking by subject? In that case that ranking must be about your study or research subject.

requirements.label: The master's, doctoral or post-master's programme must have been in English or Dutch
requirements.source_excerpt: your master’s degree programme, doctoral programme or post-master’s study programme was in english or dutch.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your master’s degree programme, doctoral programme or post-master’s study programme was in English or Dutch.

requirements.label: Foreign diplomas must be evaluated by Nuffic before they are accepted
requirements.description: IND exempts diplomas from accredited programmes in Flanders, Belgium, provided the programme is in the Flanders higher education register.
requirements.source_excerpt: all foreign diplomas have to be evaluated by nuffic before they can be accepted. this credential evaluation shows the worth of a foreign degree in the netherlands. nuffic may also check whether your diploma is genuine.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: All foreign diplomas have to be evaluated by Nuffic before they can be accepted. This credential evaluation shows the worth of a foreign degree in the Netherlands. Nuffic may also check whether your diploma is genuine.

requirements.label: A valid provisional residence permit (mvv) is needed
requirements.source_excerpt: a valid provisional residence permit (mvv) is needed for this application
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A valid provisional residence permit (MVV) is needed for this application

requirements.label: Foreign documents must be legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German
requirements.source_excerpt: have official foreign documents legalised and translated into dutch, english, french or german.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Have official foreign documents legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German.

requirements.label: The application form lists the documents you need
requirements.source_excerpt: the application form lists which documents you need. collect all documents before you apply.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The application form lists which documents you need. Collect all documents before you apply.

requirements.label: Application fee
requirements.description: Excerpt preserves IND's own broken word ('f ees') where a link splits it.
requirements.source_excerpt: the application costs € 254,00. for all fees and exceptions, visit our web page f ees: costs of an application .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The application costs € 254,00. For all fees and exceptions, visit our web page F ees: costs of an application.

requirements.label: Pay no later than 3 weeks after your appointment, and wait a week after it
requirements.description: A two-sided timing window that is easy to miss: not before one week, not after three.
requirements.source_excerpt: please wait 1 week after your appointment with the dutch representation before paying for your application. the application form explains how to pay for the application. you must pay no later than 3 weeks after the date of your appointment.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Please wait 1 week after your appointment with the Dutch representation before paying for your application. The application form explains how to pay for the application. You must pay no later than 3 weeks after the date of your appointment.

requirements.label: A further orientation year is possible after each new qualifying programme or research project
requirements.description: Recorded because people assume this permit is once-only. IND requires the new qualification to post-date the previous orientation year.
requirements.source_excerpt: the ind can give a residence permit for an orientation year after each performed research project. or after each completed study programme at a dutch higher education institution, or a doctoral programme. however, the new study programme or doctoral programme must have been completed after your previous orientation year.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The IND can give a residence permit for an orientation year after each performed research project. Or after each completed study programme at a Dutch higher education institution, or a doctoral programme. However, the new study programme or doctoral programme must have been completed after your previous orientation year.
